mission: Search for source-bound physical objects, containers, deposits, and custody chains that can test ancient Osirian body-part traditions without converting iconography or cult association into literal biological-relic claims.

QH207_32.significance: preparatory re-membering stage; bronze feet segment determines reconstructed wax body height

QH207_38.evidence_basis: 1970 radiograph is a principal surviving technological source

QH207_39.content: one more-complete bronze Osiris plus three figures with bronze mainly in foot regions; wax/cavity evidence

QH207_40.content: broken bronze feet/body segments topped by wax bodies; micro-CT documented

QH207_55.content: bronze/wax residues; scientific sampling and imaging documented

qh207_custody_correction.firewall: These are fragments and manufacturing/reconstruction stages of Osiris images. They are not evidence that biological parts of Osiris were recovered.

ehnasya_1956_cache.discovery: accidental discovery during drinking-water-line construction in 1956
ehnasya_1956_cache.current_storage: Kom Oshiem museum store, El-Fayoum, Egypt
ehnasya_1956_cache.importance: This is a modern, physically located Osiris-object cache from Heracleopolis itself, separate from Petrie's 1903-04 distributions and separate from purely textual relic-box traditions.
open_questions: whether objects formed one sealed/cache deposit or a disturbed scatter
distance and stratigraphic relation to Harsaphes/Osiris-Naref sacred architecture
individual museum numbers and conservation records
whether larger broken Osiris figure associated with the Atef feather survives
whether any container, chest, vessel, djed or organic/embalming material was found with the cache
ehnasya_1956_cache.promotion_rule: LOCAL_OSIRIS_CACHE != LOCAL_RELIC_CACHE. Promote only if find documentation binds the assemblage to a cult deposit/container or explicit relic terminology.

heracleopolis_osiris_vase_65.primary_source: Petrie, Roman Ehnasya, plate XLVIII no.65
heracleopolis_osiris_vase_65.problem: Petrie states the illustrated figurine corpus mixed excavated objects with objects bought from sebakhin and lacking dating; no.65 cannot yet be promoted to excavated relic container.
heracleopolis_osiris_vase_65.next_gate: Trace no.65 through 1904 exhibition/distribution documentation to a present museum accession and determine find/acquisition mode.

athribis_heart_lane.textual_relic: heart of Osiris associated with Athribis in later Osirian geography
athribis_heart_lane.additional_control: A lapis-lazuli human heart scarab for Pa-di-nubet invokes Osiris-Khentykhety and ties a heart-shaped funerary object to Athribite theology, but it is a human funerary amulet, not the heart of Osiris.

biggeh_leg_lane.textual_relic: left/right leg traditions centered on Biggeh/Elephantine/First Cataract
biggeh_leg_lane.archaeological_anchor: surviving Abaton/Osiris temple complex on Bigeh Island
biggeh_leg_lane.condition: site severely affected by reservoir/Nile-water fluctuations and was not relocated during the UNESCO Philae rescue
biggeh_leg_lane.firewall: extant sacred architecture plus explicit leg theology does not establish survival of a physical leg relic

candidate_priority.reason: strongest existing source-bound intersection of body-part theology, excavated protected body assemblage, stable phallus-sheath passport, stamped-gold djed evidence and actionable imaging/register gates
physically located modern corpus from the exact city of a multi-part Osirian relic-box tradition; exact find context is recoverable in principle
named canopic Osiris object from Ehnasya publication; current museum identity and find mode remain recoverable archival questions
strong textual heart tradition and physical local Osirian cult corpus, but no identified relic container
strong leg/tomb theology and surviving sanctuary, but no recovered portable relic object

canonical_formula: BODY_PART_TEXT -> LOCAL_CULT -> EXCAVATED_OR_CATALOGUED_OBJECT -> PASSPORT -> CONTAINER/CONTENT TEST -> CUSTODY -> ONLY THEN IDENTITY
canonical_seal: DO NOT COUNT AN IMAGE OF OSIRIS AS A PIECE OF OSIRIS. FIND THE CONTAINER, THE CONTENT, THE PASSPORT, AND THE HANDOFF.
